jobs.description:
The key responsibility of the Quality Control technician is for  receiving  and analyzing test material, incoming parts, product intermediates and finalized products for Research & Development, Testing & Validation, and Production using a range of instruments as well as participating in problem solving and technical troubleshooting exercises on the execution side.   
Key Responsibilities 
Key responsibilities include (but are not limited to)  
Execute work instructions and participate in laboratory functions/tasks/work.   
Follow 5S and safety protocols within the production and laboratory work environment.  
Conduct analysis on a wide range of instruments and report data/results for a diverse set of samples in the expected template and/or Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS); and maintain control charts.  
Able to understand and execute testing and validation plans for incoming parts, product intermediates, finalized products, and other material accordingly. 
Identify problems with test material, analysis methods, and instrumentation.   
Be able to troubleshoot basic to advance problems; utilizing the help of suppliers or experts for more major issues.   
Understand the fundamental principles of method development and/or method validation and able to participate in the execution.   
Able to write support documentation for standard operations.  
Maintaining instruments and measurement areas to a high standard, involving responsibility to ensure that the laboratory or production room(s)/area(s) comply with safety related guidelines, 5S guidelines, maintaining consumable inventory and instrument readiness.  
Able to train and qualifying personnel according to a skill and competence level.  
Strict adherence to Quality Assurance and Quality Control Principles.   
Participate in improvement plans and investigations for various topics.   

Accountability/Authorization 
Budget responsibility: No  
Direct reports: No  
Work Environment responsibility: No 

All employees are accountable for complying with safety regulations and actively supporting a safe workplace. 

Requirements 
Educational background and previous experience required for the role. 
Qualifications and experience  
Bachelor´s degree or master’s degree in a technical field is preferred.  
2 years experience in quality control from relevant industry is preferred.  
Specific knowledge in any relevant instrumentation, measurement system, or scientific field used by the company. (preferred)  
Familiar with quality management systems, e.g. ISO 9001, IATF16949, Total Quality Management (TQM). 
Familiar with Statistical Process Control (SPC), Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), Control Plan (CP), Lean, Six Sigma, Quality troubleshooting tools and problem-solving methodology. (Preferred)  
Curious, technically educated and preferably with a strong business background.  
Experience in Cell Manufacturing, or Test and Validation is an advantage.  

 Specific skills & Knowledge 
Knowledge of Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS) or other sample tracking software is a plus.  
Excellent English skills, both written and oral, are essential. Basic Swedish and other language skills are a plus. You should have good communication skills and be able to work in close collaboration with colleagues from many different teams.  
High work ethic, critical thinking, and strong problem-solving skills are a must.  
This role requires the ability to stand for extended periods and perform manual labor in physically demanding environments. This can include 100% working hours allocation into clean-rooms and dry-rooms, while wearing appropriate PPE. The role also requires working shifts and working in multiple process areas, according to business needs. This role requires working full-time on the shop floor, supporting operation.

Areas of ownership:

Drive the modernization from legacy Objective-C to a modern Swift + SwiftUI stack

Build and modernize iOS features using Swift, SwiftUI, and Combine

Contribute to architecture decisions (VIPER to MVVM-C transition, Combine, platform improvements)

Collaborate closely with Android, Web, Product, Design to ship the right solutions

Ship to the App Store and monitor what happens after release

Improve tooling, testing practices, and CI/CD where needed

Requirements:

5+ years building iOS apps

Proficient in Swift, SwiftUI, and Combine

Comfortable maintaining and modernizing legacy Objective-C

Solid grasp of iOS architecture patterns (MVVM-C, VIPER)

Shipped production iOS apps to the App Store, including post-release monitoring

Experience with REST and/or GraphQL, with solid error handling and async patterns

Can work independently and ship without constant oversight

Write unit tests, cover edge cases, and give code reviews that favor simple solutions

Work effectively with AI coding tools

Good English (we write and speak it all day)

jobs.description:
The Opportunity
Join our HVDC R&D team at Hitachi Energy and help pioneer the future of energy transmission. We are now looking for a R&D Senior Engineer to contribute to the development of advanced control strategies for HVDC systems, including Modular Multilevel Converter (MMC) and Line Commutated Converter (LCC) technologies. This is a unique opportunity to work in a global, collaborative environment focused on innovation and technical excellence.
In this role, you will design and optimize control algorithms for MMC- and LCC-based HVDC systems, including multiterminal HVDC (MTDC) configurations. You will also perform small-signal stability analysis, harmonic studies, and transient simulations to ensure robust and reliable system performance. A key part of your responsibilities will be to lead system-level dynamic performance evaluations and drive continuous improvements in control strategies. Additionally, you will mentor junior engineers and actively contribute to strategic technology roadmaps, helping shape the future direction of HVDC control systems and power electronics design.
How You Will Make an Impact
Contribute to converter topology design, control and protection, and main circuit development for VSC HVDC and LCC HVDC systems.
Perform insulation coordination, steady-state and dynamic stability studies, harmonic analysis, and performances under various conditions.
Address evolving customer requirements with a strong stakeholder focus.
Uphold our core values of safety, integrity, and responsibility.
Collaborate in a supportive and agile team environment.
Take ownership of both technology and your personal development.

Your Background
PhD or MSc in Power Systems, Electrical Machines and Drives, or Power Electronics Control.
Several years of experience in HVDC or FACTS technologies.
Strong knowledge of MMC topologies and HVDC control systems.
Experience in small-signal stability analysis and transient simulations.
Skilled in simulation tools: MATLAB, PSCAD/EMTDC, EMTP-RV, and ideally Modelica, RTDS, Python, C/C++.
Open-minded, solution-oriented, and collaborative with strong organizational skills.
Proficiency in English is required

What we offer 
Collective agreement
Flexible working time
Health care and wellness allowance
Fantastic career possibilities within Hitachi Energy both within Sweden and globally
Mentor to support you throughout onboard phase
Various trainings and education supporting employee development​
Diversified company with over 70+ nationalities working in Sweden
Supplementary compensation for parental leave
Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks

As we scale production, reliable automation and electrical systems become critical for quality, uptime and operational performance.

Work with advanced manufacturing technologies and processes.

What Success Looks Like
Within 12 months, you have:

Improved reliability and uptime across critical systems.

Strengthened automation performance and process stability.

Successfully supported the commissioning of new production equipment.

Location: Danderyd, Sweden

About Piab Group: 
At Piab Group, we enhance our customers' productivity, sustainability, and safety through innovative industrial automation. Since 1951, we've envisioned an automated world where no resources are wasted, and no humans are injured. With annual sales of approximately 3 billion SEK and more than 1,400 employees, Piab is a global organization serving clients in over 100 countries through a vast network of subsidiaries and channel partners. Piab Group has been owned by Patricia Industries, part of Investor AB, since 2018 

Job Mission: 
The role as a Legal Counsel at Piab Group is two-fold. In addition to providing legal advice and support on a wide range of areas, you will be responsible for driving and managing the legal compliance agenda at Piab Group. Compliance is pivotal for Piab Group and our compliance agenda includes areas such as global trade compliance, anti-trust compliance, anti-bribery and corruption compliance. We are looking for a highly motivated, pragmatic and skilled Legal Counsel who wants to join a fast-growing company in an international environment. 
You will report directly to Group Head of Legal and the role is based in Danderyd, Stockholm. 

Key Responsibilities include: 
Legal Advice: Proactively identify legal challenges and offering business-oriented support to all levels of the organization, worldwide, on legal issues.
Business Contracts: draft and review business contracts, leases, and other legal documents and recommend revisions as necessary. Enhance standard template agreements.
Legal Investigations: Conduct internal investigations on various matters, including whistleblower reports.
Monitoring of Laws and Regulations: Stay informed about global legislative changes and update Piab Group’s policies and procedures accordingly.
Risk Management: Assist with the implementation and management of Piab Group’s risk management program, performing risk assessments and implementing measures to mitigate identified risks.
Corporate Governance: Provide support and advice on corporate governance.
Compliance Programs: Develop, implement, and maintain our comprehensive compliance programs, ensuring adherence to laws such as anti-trust, anti-bribery and trade sanctions.
Trainings: Develop and deliver training to ensure awareness and understanding of compliance matters and to promote a culture of ethical awareness.

Qualifications: 
A Swedish degree in law (LL.M) or similar
Minimum 6 years of legal experience from a law firm and/or corporate legal department, preferably in an international context.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
Broad base of legal knowledge in compliance, litigation, corporate governance, contract law, M&A, and commercial transactions.
Fluency in spoken and written English and Swedish, with effective communication skills to interact with diverse organizational levels 
Experience in working independently and as part of a team, within both local and virtual teams, promoting cooperation across the organization 

How to Apply: 
If you are passionate about innovation and want to make a difference in the world of automation, we would love to hear from you! Apply over your LinkedIn profile or use the following link to upload your CV.

Our client is a leading player in the banking and finance sector with over 100 years of history – yet fully focused on the future. If you want to combine technology, innovation, and finance in a company that challenges traditional norms, this is the place for you.

A good understanding of accounting principles and financial statements, with some knowledge of IFRS.

Experience with financial close and reporting processes.

Strong Excel skills.

Professional fluency in English.

jobs.occupation: Partnership Operations Manager - Creator & Brand Partnerships
jobs.description:
About the Opportunity
We are looking for a highly organized and commercially minded Operations Manager to support the operational execution of brand and creator partnership initiatives across the EMEA region.
This role sits at the intersection of operations, contract management, stakeholder engagement, and process governance. You will act as a key operational partner to commercial teams, ensuring that partnership agreements, funding approvals, and contractual requirements are processed efficiently while maintaining compliance with internal policies and eligibility criteria.
The ideal candidate combines strong business acumen with exceptional communication skills and thrives in a fast-paced environment where multiple stakeholders and deadlines must be managed simultaneously.
Key ResponsibilitiesIn this role, you will play a key part in managing partnership operations, contract governance, and stakeholder engagement across multiple markets.
Manage end-to-end contract and approval workflows for creator and brand partnership programs.
Review partnership requests and ensure compliance with eligibility, funding, and business requirements.
Coordinate contract execution and approvals with internal and external stakeholders.
Act as the final operational gatekeeper for partnership and funding approvals.
Ensure all commercial terms, content usage rights, geographic restrictions, and talent fees are agreed upon prior to campaign launch.
Partner closely with sales, marketing, and business teams across EMEA, providing guidance on contractual and operational processes.
Maintain accurate documentation, reporting, and operational records.
Monitor KPIs and operational metrics to support business performance and process improvements.
Identify opportunities to streamline workflows, improve efficiency, and drive operational excellence through standardization and automation.
Required QualificationsExperience in Operations, Business Operations, Process Management, Contract Administration, Commercial Operations, or a similar field.
Strong understanding of business processes, contract handling, and financial data management.
Proven experience managing stakeholders in fast-paced and commercially driven environments.
Ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities and deadlines.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and relationship-building abilities.
Fluency in English, both written and spoken.
Preferred Background
We are particularly interested in candidates with previous experience as:
Process Manager within a media or advertising agency
Producer or Project Manager within a creative agency
Junior Go-to-Market Specialist
Talent Manager, Artist Relations Manager, or Creator Partnerships professional
Business Operations Specialist
Working Model
This is a hybrid assignment based in central Stockholm:
Location: Stockholm, Sweden
Duration: 6-Month Consultancy Assignment
Start Date: As soon as possible / Early January 2027
Working Hours: Full-time (40 hours per week)
Office: Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday
Remote: Monday and Friday

Standard business hours apply, with occasional flexibility required for urgent escalations or operational incidents.
What Success Looks LikeYou will be successful in this role if you can effectively balance stakeholder needs with operational governance, ensure contracts and approvals move smoothly through the business, and proactively identify opportunities to improve efficiency, compliance, and scalability across partnership operations.
If you are passionate about business operations, contract management, and process excellence within a dynamic commercial environment, we would love to hear from you.
This is a consultancy role via Adecco.
